mapper.select: select w.*, u.username, u.avatar from weibo w left join user u on w.user_id = u.id order by w.create_time desc
select w.*, u.username, u.avatar from weibo w left join user u on w.user_id = u.id where w.user_id = #{userId} order by w.create_time desc
select w.*, u.username, u.avatar from weibo w left join user u on w.user_id = u.id order by w.like_count desc, w.create_time desc
select w.*, u.username, u.avatar from weibo w left join user u on w.user_id = u.id where w.content like concat('%', #{q}, '%') order by w.create_time desc
select coalesce(sum(like_count), 0) from weibo where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into weibo(user_id, content, img_url, like_count, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{content}, #{imgUrl}, 0, now())
mapper.update: update weibo set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{id}
update weibo set like_count = like_count - 1 where id = #{id}
